name: Daily loop — EOD wrap
description: Scheduled /eod-wrap with draft ticket comments only (no unattended writes).

prompts.text:
You are running the daily-work-loop-copilot end-of-day wrap (equivalent to /eod-wrap --update-tickets draft).

1. Use MCP get_daily_loop_command for eod-wrap and follow that procedure.
2. Gather (daily-loop-exploration): today's git activity and GitHub issues/PRs for configured owner/repo and this workspace.
3. Draft (daily-loop-execution): full EOD template — shipped, in progress, blocked, draft issue comments, open loops table.
4. Parent Check: verify open loops have owner, next step, and date per plugin verification.md; note PASS/FAIL.
5. INTEGRATION_STACK=github. Do NOT create .cursor/daily-loop-write-approved. Do NOT post GitHub or Jira comments. Do NOT merge or close anything.
6. Output the complete EOD markdown in the automation result.
